相关性: 该论文涉及LPBF制备多孔钛合金脊柱融合器，与用户研究方向中的多孔结构及力学性能相关，但未直接涉及应力遮挡或疲劳测试。

Motivation· To design interbody fusion cages with gradient porosity that match the mechanical requirements for spinal arthroplasty.
Method· Fabricated Ti6Al4V cages with gradient porosity using selective laser melting (SLM).
Result· Achieved controllable pore distribution and evaluated mechanical properties.
Validation· Mechanical properties were verified through finite element simulation.

Uncertainty quantification in polysilicon MEMS through on-chip testing and reduced-order modelling

Medium FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Save for project mechanical_testing Exp. validation UQ
Ramin Mirzazadeh, Saeed Eftekhar Azam, Eelco Jansen, Stefano Mariani 2017-04-01 10.1109/eurosime.2017.7926242
单位: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Milano, Italy
通讯: Ramin Mirzazadeh @ Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Milano, Italy
相关性: 该论文将POD-Kriging降阶模型与贝叶斯反演结合用于MEMS不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至植入物力学代理建模与UQ。
边界: This paper focuses on MEMS polysilicon beams, not on biomedical implants or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling.
动机· 量化MEMS中微尺度不确定性对系统响应的影响。
方法· 结合POD-Kriging降阶模型与TMCMC贝叶斯反演进行参数估计。
结果· 成功估计了多晶硅力学性能和几何参数的不确定性。
验证· 通过片上测试实验与高保真有限元模型对比验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify micro-scale uncertainties affecting the behavior of polysilicon MEMS devices.
Method· A reduced-order model combining proper orthogonal decomposition and Kriging interpolation is used within a transitional Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithm for Bayesian inverse parameter estimation.
Result· Uncertainty levels in polysilicon mechanical properties and geometry were systematically estimated from experimental data.
Validation· Experimental on-chip testing and high-fidelity finite element simulations were used to validate the reduced-order model and uncertainty estimates.

Dennis Janssen, Thom Bitter, B Willem Schreurs, Tim Marriott, Imran Khan et al. University of Twente Research Information 2017-04-01 link
单位: Radboud University Medical Center Nijmegen, The Netherlands#TAB#
通讯: Dennis Janssen @ Radboud University Medical Center Nijmegen, The Netherlands#TAB#
相关性: 该论文聚焦于髋关节假体头-锥接口的微动和接触力学，而非股骨柄与骨界面的应力遮挡或微动。
边界: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress shielding or micromotion at the bone-implant interface; it focuses on the head-neck taper junction, not the femoral stem.
动机· 研究组装力和角度对髋关节假体头-锥接口微动和接触压力的影响。
方法· 建立Bimetric锥体和适配器的有限元模型，采用弹塑性材料属性，验证推入和拉出实验。
结果· 增加组装力降低平均微动和接触压力，但30°角组装时效果减弱。
验证· 通过推入和拉出实验验证有限元接触条件。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effect of assembly force and angle on contact mechanics and fretting at the head-taper junction of hip implants.
Method· Finite element models of the Bimetric taper and adaptor with elastic-plastic material properties were validated against push-on and pull-off experiments.
Result· Higher assembly force reduced average micromotion and contact pressure, but assembly at a 30° angle diminished these benefits.
Validation· FE contact conditions were validated by push-on and pull-off experiments.

相关性: 论文关于PEEK植入体羟基磷灰石涂层的生物相容性，但与用户关注的AM生物材料（多孔结构、LPBF制造、疲劳性能）无关。

Motivation· To enhance the biocompatibility and osseointegration of bioinert PEEK implants by forming a stable hydroxyapatite coating.

Validation· Validation was performed using in vitro human mesenchymal stem cell assays and in vivo implantation in minipig iliac bone defects and lumbar intervertebral space.

相关性: 该论文讨论全髋关节置换术后异位骨化的预防与治疗，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡、微动或有限元分析。
边界: This paper is a clinical review on heterotopic ossification after THA, with no biomechanical modeling, no implant stress shielding analysis, no micromotion quantification, and no finite element simulation.
动机· 综述全髋关节置换术后异位骨化的预防与治疗。
方法· 文献综述，总结危险因素、治疗方法和预防措施。
结果· 异位骨化常见但多无症状，严重时需手术切除并预防复发。
验证· 无实验验证，为临床综述。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To review the prevention and treatment of heterotopic ossification after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Literature review summarizing risk factors, treatment options (physical therapy, surgical excision), and prophylaxis (NSAIDs, radiotherapy).
Result· Heterotopic ossification is common but usually asymptomatic; severe cases require surgical excision and prophylaxis to prevent recurrence.
Validation· No experimental validation; this is a clinical review.

Seasonal variations in the incidence of deep vein thrombosis following total knee or hip arthroplasty

通讯: Liang Qiao @ Department of Sports Medicine and Adult Reconstructive Surgery, Drum Tower Hospital, School of Medicine, Nanjing Univers
相关性: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术后深静脉血栓的季节性变化，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical analysis of the femoral stem; it is purely a clinical epidemiological study.
动机· 探讨季节对全膝或全髋关节置换术后深静脉血栓发生率的影响
方法· 回顾性分析2363例患者术后DVT发生率，按季节和年龄分组统计
结果· 冬季DVT发生率最高（22.50%），老年患者（≥65岁）季节差异更显著
验证· 临床回顾性数据统计分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether seasonal variations affect the incidence of deep vein thrombosis after total knee or hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective study of 2363 patients undergoing TKA or THA, with DVT incidence analyzed by season and age group.
Result· Winter showed the highest DVT incidence (22.50%), especially in patients aged ≥65 years.
Validation· Clinical retrospective data with statistical analysis.

Pranav Jogi, Overend TJ, J Kramer DOAJ (DOAJ: Directory of Open Access Journals) 2017-04-01 link
相关性: 该论文研究全髋和全膝关节置换术后患者的平衡功能评估，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或生物力学建模。
边界: This paper focuses on clinical balance outcome measures after arthroplasty, with no quantification of proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or any finite element analysis.
动机· 探究全髋和全膝关节置换术后临床平衡评估与实验室平衡测量的关系
方法· 使用四种临床量表和一种力板测量评估术后5-7周患者的平衡功能
结果· Berg平衡量表与力板95%椭圆面积相关性最高
验证· 临床患者数据验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine the relationship between clinically based balance measures and laboratory-based force plate measures in patients after total hip and knee arthroplasty.
Method· Four clinical outcome measures (BBS, TUG, ABC, WOMAC-function) and one force plate measure (95% ellipse area) were assessed in 54 patients at 5-7 weeks post-surgery.
Result· The Berg Balance Scale showed the highest correlations with force plate ellipse area among the clinical measures.
Validation· Clinical study with 54 patients.
